parts: Imagine sending money to family abroad,
and it arriving in minutes, on a Sunday night.
Nobody wants their rent money to drop ten percent overnight.
A stablecoin is a crypto token designed to stay worth one fixed amount,
for every token, the issuer says it holds a dollar in cash or short-term government bonds.
Because they move on blockchains, they can cross borders at any hour,
Today, more than three hundred billion dollars' worth of stablecoins are in circulation.
The catch: a stablecoin is only as good as its reserves and its issuer.
Some have lost their peg. And the rules differ from country to country.
A stablecoin isn't an investment that grows.
It's a digital dollar that moves fast.
